title: Rune Stone Aurora
description: A large weathered monolith covered in glowing golden runes stands tilted in a dark mystical landscape beneath a vibrant green and purple aurora borealis. In the foreground, three smaller rectangular rune plaques in blue, white, and red display similar symbols with numbers #935, #78, and #956, surrounded by scattered feathers, twigs, and dark liquid on the ground.
